Please share this as widely as you can. The government needs to know what we are going through. It has been more than 10 days since the floods in Nepal, and our parents, who had gone on the Kailash Yatra, are still missing. We are still waiting for any news, hoping and praying that they are safe. We have visited the police station two or three times to file reports. We have given blood samples for DNA testing and fingerprints to help with identification. But we are still waiting for answers. We are not only waiting for our parents. We are waiting for the people who are the pillars of our lives. My mother used to tell me, “Whenever you feel sad, put on some eyeliner.” Today, I put on eyeliner, but she is not here to see it. I feel her absence in everything. My father had promised that, after returning from the Kailash Yatra, he would teach me finance and we would begin our weight-loss journey together. I am still waiting for him to come home. Please, we need answers. We need the government to hear us. We need every possible effort to be made to locate the missing pilgrims and bring clarity to their families. Please share this. Our parents are still missing, and we are still waiting. #NepalArmy #Nepal #nepalnews #floodrescue
